company: FortiTech Solutions (fictional sample company) is a software company founded in 2018 that helps small and mid-sized businesses manage sales, customer support and reporting in one place.

chunks.title: About FortiTech
chunks.text: FortiTech Solutions was founded in 2018 and helps small and mid-sized businesses manage sales, customer support and reporting in one place. More than 2,000 teams use our products.

chunks.title: FortiCRM
chunks.text: FortiCRM tracks your contacts, deals and sales pipeline in one place, with automatic follow-up reminders, email logging and simple sales automation. It is built for teams of 5 to 200 people.

chunks.title: FortiDesk
chunks.text: FortiDesk is our customer support helpdesk. It turns emails and chat messages into tickets, assigns them to agents and tracks response times against targets you set.

chunks.title: FortiInsights
chunks.text: FortiInsights is our analytics add-on. It adds live dashboards, sales forecasts and scheduled reports on top of FortiCRM and FortiDesk. It is available on the Pro and Enterprise plans.

chunks.title: Pricing
chunks.text: FortiCRM has three plans: Starter at $19 per user per month (up to 10 users), Pro at $49 per user per month, and Enterprise with custom pricing for 50+ users. FortiDesk is $29 per agent per month and FortiInsights is a $15 per user per month add-on. Annual billing includes 2 months free.

chunks.title: Free trial and demo
chunks.text: Every product has a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. We also offer a 30-minute live demo with a sales specialist.

chunks.title: Onboarding and training services
chunks.text: Our onboarding service starts at $1,500 and includes data migration from spreadsheets or other CRMs, setup of your pipeline, and two live training sessions for your team.

chunks.title: Integrations
chunks.text: FortiCRM integrates with Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Zapier and QuickBooks, and offers a REST API for custom connections.

chunks.title: Security and data
chunks.text: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. FortiTech is SOC 2 Type II certified and hosts customer data on cloud servers in the US or EU, whichever region you choose.

chunks.title: Customer support
chunks.text: Starter and Pro customers get email and chat support on weekdays, and Enterprise customers get 24/7 support with a dedicated account manager.

chunks.title: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: There are no long-term contracts: monthly plans can be cancelled at any time, and you can upgrade or downgrade between plans whenever you like.

chunks.title: Benefits
chunks.text: Teams using FortiCRM typically spend less time on manual follow-ups and respond to new leads faster, because reminders, email logging and reporting happen automatically.
